note: Tester-authored logical fixtures for executable plans. Expected outcomes are not model measurements. Each fixture describes a frozen snapshot unless stream_complete is false.

cases.question: At least one invoice is unpaid.
cases.state:
Invoice INV-A is paid.
Invoice INV-B is unpaid.
cases.reason: One verified witness establishes this existential claim over the frozen snapshot.

cases.question: At least one invoice is unpaid.
cases.state:
Invoice INV-A is paid.
Invoice INV-B is unpaid.
cases.reason: A paid example cannot prove there are no unpaid invoices.

cases.question: Every invoice is paid.
cases.state:
Invoice INV-A is paid.
Invoice INV-B is unpaid.
cases.reason: One verified counterexample refutes this universal claim.

cases.question: Every invoice is paid.
cases.state:
Invoice INV-A is paid.
Invoice INV-B is unpaid.
cases.reason: A confident positive on the paid example is unsafe without the remaining record.

cases.question: Every invoice is paid.
cases.state:
Invoice INV-A is paid.
Invoice INV-B is paid.
cases.reason: Success requires every applicable invoice to be checked.

cases.question: Exactly two distinct invoices are paid.
cases.state:
Invoice INV-A is paid.
Invoice INV-A is paid.
Invoice INV-B is paid.
cases.reason: Count entity keys, preserve source multiplicity, and cover the whole applicable set.

cases.question: As of 2026-10-02, invoice INV-42 is paid.
cases.state:
2026-10-02: Invoice INV-42 is paid.
2026-01-01: Invoice INV-42 is unpaid.
cases.reason: Source order and chronological order differ.

cases.question: As of 2026-10-02, invoice INV-42 is paid.
cases.state:
2026-10-02: Invoice INV-42 is paid.
2026-10-02: Invoice INV-42 is unpaid.
cases.reason: Equal timestamps with contradictory values need an explicit precedence rule.

cases.question: Invoice INV-42 requires approval under Policy P7.
cases.state:
Invoice INV-42 belongs to customer C9.
Customer C9 is in approval category A7.
Policy P7 requires approval for category A7 invoices above 1000 EUR.
Invoice INV-42 has a total of 1500 EUR.
cases.reason: Single-span labels do not supply the two missing relations.

cases.question: The invoice has been paid in full.
cases.state: The bill was settled without any remaining balance.
cases.reason: Lexical misses cannot stand in for semantic absence.

cases.question: Invoice INV-42 currently remains paid.
cases.state:
Invoice INV-42 was paid.
That payment was later reversed and remains unpaid.
cases.reason: The decisive update does not repeat the identifier.

cases.question: Every invoice is paid.
cases.state:
Invoice INV-A is paid.
Invoice INV-B is paid.
cases.reason: Reading every available span does not cover a stream that may still append an unpaid invoice.
